status: all twelve tools are registered with the reference's published schemas; get_manifest answers its xml mode and get_manifest_components, list_resource_files, read_resource and query_resources answer; every call recorded from the reference engine (dexsql 0.1.0) was replayed against this build and compared field by field

real_application.what: the public NewPipe 0.28.6 APK: the manifest as XML, every component, every member, rows of every resource type, configurations and filters, 60 layouts and other XML, binary members
real_application.recording: artifacts/local/a0-probe/newpipe.jsonl (ignored: it holds the application's own strings and layouts); made by artifacts/mdd-072/probe/probe_newpipe.py against the pinned reference

ARGUMENT_RANGE_SHAPE.explanation: an argument outside its range is a JSON-RPC invalid-params error here, an isError tool result in the reference

CONTROL_CHARS.explanation: the reference rewrites or drops control characters in attribute values; this engine keeps them exactly

ENUM_ON_STRING_TYPE.explanation: the reference names a flag word from the data word of a string-typed protectionLevel; this engine shows the string

ERROR_WORDING.explanation: both refuse with the same kind; the message is worded differently

FRAMEWORK_ENUMS.explanation: the reference names the enumerations and flags of the framework's layout attributes (fill_parent, horizontal, top|fill_horizontal) from an embedded table; this engine names only installLocation, launchMode, protectionLevel and foregroundServiceType, and writes the number for any other

FRAMEWORK_NAMES.explanation: the reference names ids of the framework's own resources from an embedded table; this engine writes the id

LIST_TABLES_SHAPE.explanation: list_tables answers objects here, names in the reference (declared in MDD-042)

NAMESPACES_KEPT.explanation: the XML view here writes every namespace declaration and namespaced attribute under the prefix the document gave it; the reference writes the android namespace only, always as android

NEGATIVE_DIMENSION.explanation: the reference reads the mantissa of a dimension as unsigned; a negative dimension is written -3dip here (the platform's reading) and 16777213dip there

RAW_WORD_IN_LAYOUT.explanation: in a layout (not the manifest) the reference writes the stored word of a typed value, a dimension, a reference, an integer or a boolean, as an unsigned decimal; this engine spells the typed value

ROW_BUDGET.explanation: the page ends one row earlier or later under a small max_bytes; the rows shown are the reference's rows

STRICT_INPUT.explanation: a malformed input (wrong table magic, an AXML namespace not declared, a repeated attribute) is refused here and read leniently by the reference

STRING_VALUE_AS_INDEX.explanation: in a layout the reference writes a string-typed android attribute as its pool index; this engine writes the string

UNKNOWN_UNIT.explanation: a dimension or fraction unit outside the platform's table is written out in full here, as a bare number by the reference

XML_TEXT_NODES.explanation: the XML view here keeps text nodes; the reference omits them

decode_replay_with_the_manifest_xml_reco.result: cases: 257/257 equal (118 exactly, 139 with a declared difference), 1 not run; methods: 252/252 equal; unclean refusals: 0

residual: the recorded answers are those of dexsql 0.1.0, windows-amd64 build only; dexsql 0.1.1 was not probed for the resource tools

the inputs are small synthetic archives built by tests/fixtures/resources/generate.py and the probe scripts, plus the project's earlier fixtures; no real application was compared, and the NewPipe APK was not used for these tools

the reference leaves out text nodes, writes every android attribute under the prefix android, names ids of the framework's resources, and drops control characters; this engine keeps the first, second and fourth exactly and writes framework ids as ids (declared classes XML_TEXT_NODES, NAMESPACES_KEPT, FRAMEWORK_NAMES, CONTROL_CHARS), so a client that compares XML text with the reference's will see these differences

only installLocation, launchMode and protectionLevel are given framework names; every other android attribute is a number, because the binary XML does not carry the attribute's declared type and no framework table is embedded

the reference reads leniently a table with a wrong header type, binary XML with an undeclared namespace and an element with a repeated attribute; this engine refuses them (declared class STRICT_INPUT), so an application that relies on lenient reading is refused by the resource tools
compact resource entries, overlays and staged aliases are not read: a table with a compact entry is refused as unsupported_capability, the others are passed over and counted in skipped_chunks
style spans of pool strings are validated and kept in the parsed table but not shown
the 64 MiB resource cap and the table budgets are enforced by the same code paths as the others and are tested at small sizes only; no 64 MiB member was read here

the row budget of query_resources, list_resource_files and get_manifest_components counts the answer as sent (structured content and its text copy) and reproduces the reference's page sizes at one recorded point; page boundaries under a small max_bytes can differ by a row (declared class ROW_BUDGET)

the mutation check runs in .github/workflows/mutation-resources.yml, not on a developer machine. Its first runs found survivors that were gaps in the tests, not in the engine (20 in the third run, 1 in the fourth); each got a test, and the fifth run (44247914806) killed all 118 mutants and the unmutated tree passes. The mutation results of MDD-042, 070, 071 and 084 were rerun on the same code and killed 57/57, 59/59, 67/67 and 12/12. A mutant the replay kills is held only as well as the recorded inputs reach it, and the replay about the real application is not part of the Actions run (its APK is a local file)
